python_scripts.note: N_BINS=1024 truncates rfft output (1025 for n_fft=2048). Audio from audio_library uses _SR=44100.

web_app.hop_length_samples: N/A (AnalyserNode updates on getFloatFrequencyData calls, typically every requestAnimationFrame ~60 Hz)
web_app.note: analyser.fftSize = FFT_SIZE * 2 with FFT_SIZE=1024. Web Audio API AnalyserNode uses Blackman window by default; window function is not configurable.

figure_only_not_pipeline.purpose: Spectrogram visualization for paper figure only; not used for coefficient mapping.

differences.window_function: Python pipeline uses Hann; web app uses Blackman (browser AnalyserNode default, not configurable).
differences.hop_and_frame_rate: Python: fixed hop 512 samples, frame rate ≈86.13 Hz. Web: no fixed hop; updates at requestAnimationFrame rate (~60 Hz).
differences.sampling_rate: Python: fixed 44100 Hz from audio files. Web: AudioContext.sampleRate (typically 44100 or 48000, not set in code).
